title: Subset intersection cancellation
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a set, let $U\subseteq\alpha$ be finite, and let $g$ assign a real number to every finite subset of $\alpha$. For each finite $S\subseteq\alpha$, define $E_S(g)=\sum_{A,B\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|A|}(-1)^{|S|-|B|}g(A\cap B)$. Then $\sum_{S\subseteq U}E_S(g)=g(U)$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is a real-valued function on finite subsets of $\alpha$
replaced: For a finite set $U$ and a real function $g$ on finite subsets, put $E_S(g)=\sum_{A,B\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|A|}(-1)^{|S|-|B|}g(A\cap B)$. Then $\sum_{S\subseteq U}E_S(g)=g(U)$.
